objectiveEnglish: Practice four daily-report nouns, recognize the sentence about attached photos, and make one informal request for photos.

activities.promptJapanese: 次の英語を読んで、意味（日報）を確認しましょう。
「要約（まとめ）」を、the を付けた英語で思い出して言ってください。
聞こえた英文を、3つの候補から選んでください。
activities.targetEnglish: Before and after photos are attached.
candidateOptionsEnglish: Before and after photos are attached.
Hey, send me the photos of the plywood.
With nothing further, I sign off.
activities.hearScriptCandidateEnglish: Before and after photos are attached.

activities.promptJapanese: 「記録写真（証拠写真）」を、the を付けた英語で入力してください。
仲間に気軽な言い方で「ねえ、合板の写真を送って。」と英語で言ってみましょう。
activities.targetEnglish: Hey, send me the photos of the plywood.

activities.promptJapanese: 「未完了事項」を、the を付けた英語で書いてください。

forms.explanationJapanese: wrote は write（書く）の過去形です。終わったことを述べるときに使います。

forms.exampleEnglish: Before and after photos are attached.
forms.explanationJapanese: are attached は「添付されている」という受け身です。報告書では、誰が添付したかを言わずにこの形をよく使います。

forms.exampleEnglish: send me the photos of the plywood
forms.explanationJapanese: 動詞の原形で始める命令文です。send me ～ は「私に～を送って」という、仲間同士の気軽な頼み方です。

dictionary.senseJapanese: その日の作業についてまとめた報告書。
内容を短くまとめたもの。この課では、日報の中の項目名として使います。
作業の記録として残す写真。この課では、日報に添付する写真を指します。

roles.learner: Rogelio, the crew lead, asks Kevin for the plywood photos and then reads report wording aloud.
roles.partner: Kevin receives the photo request and listens; he has no scripted reply.

speaking.openingEnglish: Hey, send me the photos of the plywood.
speaking.closureEnglish: Before and after photos are attached.
objectivesEnglish: Ask Kevin informally to send the photos of the plywood.
Say the report nouns: the daily report, the summary, the photo evidence and the open items.
Read aloud the report sentence about the attached photos.

complication.sourceEnglish: Before sending it, Rogelio read the report again and corrected two numbers.
complication.languageGoalEnglish: Review the source report/photo wording after two numbers were corrected; no completeness or repair authorization inferred.

internalReviewNotes: ALL report/structural source faces remain held. Partial report/photo/register language proposals only; full daily-report objective incomplete.

Roofing square/quantity and material reconciliation, deck repair/replacement authorization, structural condition, photo sufficiency, forecast/work schedule and signoff scope remain internal source/domain holds.
Japanese, roofing and dictionary qualified review remains open. AI assistance is not qualified approval. No audio generated or registered; Hear remains a text candidate only.

Partial scope: report nouns, the attached-photos sentence and one informal photo request only. Quantities, deck replacement, ridge cap, membrane, underlayment, change-order and sign-off language are excluded from productive practice.
Card 20 ('With nothing further, I sign off.') appears only as a receptive hear distractor. It is a letter closing in the source, not an approval or sign-off of work.

The speaking task is a provisional practice adaptation: Rogelio's photo request plus reading report wording aloud. The source does not establish Kevin as a recipient of the report, gives him no reply and does not state his job role.
Square, deck/sheet, ridge cap, membrane and underlayment senses need product, locale and dictionary review before any of them is taught.
Change-order, weather and quantity lines are source scene facts, not authorization or verified figures; line 16 says Rogelio corrected two numbers before sending.
Japanese terms 日報, 要約, 記録写真, 未完了事項 and 合板 (plywood) need Japanese and roofing term review.
